subject: Confirmation of your flight booking
body: Dear John, We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on September 15th, 2021. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: 9:00 AM Arrival: 12:00 PM Seat: 12A Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
